title: Pentagon Functions for Two-Loop Leading-Colour pp->ttH Amplitudes with a Light-Quark Loop
description: 2-loop planar 5-point penta-box, two on-shell tops (m_t) + off-shell boson q^2 + 2 massless legs; massive k1-line (rho2,rho3), nested square roots; 111 masters
mapping_notes: Order rho1..rho11 kept, k1=l1,k2=l2, all p incoming, sum p=0. Independent externals p1..p4, p5=-(p1+p2+p3+p4) substituted. v_ij=2p_i.p_j. Given v12,v23,v34,v45,v15,mt2,q2: v13=v45-2mt2-q2-v12-v23, v14=-(2mt2+v12+v13+v15), v24=-(v45+v14+v34); gram p_i.p_j=v_ij/2, p1^2=p3^2=mt2, p2^2=q2, p4^2=0. Checked: all U,F monomial coefficients positive (Euclidean).

integrals_meaning.[1^8,-1,0,0]: top sector with ISP rho9 numerator

normalization: Paper: (e^{gamma_E} mu^2)^{2eps} prod d^dl/(i pi^{d/2}), rho=q^2-m^2 (+i0). DiffExp FT: denominators D=m^2-q^2 (Euclidean-positive), measure prod d^dk/(i pi^{d/2}), no exp(L eps gamma_E) (see de22/docs/amflow-comparison.md, feynman-families.md). Paper Minkowski integral with (q^2-m^2+i0) denominators = (-1)^{sum nu} * DiffExp value (numerator powers included in sum nu).
confidence: high for family definition (verbatim eq.22); point is my Euclidean choice. No master-integral numbers printed (only physical points; funcs.m pentagon-function values are not on arXiv as ancillary files and are canonical combos from Febres Cordero et al. 2024).
